title: What are the atoms of the triple bond with the molecule "TR041"?
question: What are the atoms of the triple bond with the molecule "TR041"?

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT T1.atom_id, T1.atom_id2
FROM connected AS T1
INNER JOIN BondDetails AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
INNER JOIN MoleculeDetails AS T3 ON T1.bond_id = T3.bond_id
INNER JOIN molecule AS T4 ON T3.molecule_id = T4.molecule_id
WHERE T4.molecule_id = 'TR041'
  AND T2.bond_type = '#'
